title: Credit Risk Analysis with Synthetic Data Generation
summary: A Jupyter notebook project that uses synthetic data to address class imbalance in a credit risk (loan default) prediction model, comparing SDV-generated tabular data against LLM-generated data. It runs SDV's CTGAN, GaussianCopula, and TVAE single-table synthesizers, along with SDV's evaluation functions, to generate and assess synthetic training data.
evidence: Projet_Data_Mining.ipynb:459-471 imports CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table and fits each on df
